answer: The registry is consulted again every epoch, and a record that does not match the issuer's own books ends the seat. Each of 209 aliases needs its own authority-backed record, and the live check behind each one makes bulk forgery cost more than the reward. A marine engineer certificate is the credential: a certificate the authority renews after sea service years. Watch the vault: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the juniper bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the anchor audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
